svg.title: Authority layers used in the manual
svg.desc: Four stacked layers distinguish legal requirements, manufacturer guidance, confirmed BOPRC procedures and proposed BOPRC policy.
svg.text: Civil Aviation Rules and transport instruments; other applicable law and permissions.
Aircraft limitations, manuals, maintenance advice and supported workflows.
An approved internal process, system owner or required record.
A review-draft control that is not yet an approved instruction.
Where sources conflict, law prevails. Current aircraft manuals and approved internal procedures then govern the task.
